textbookText: Project work Visit a chemical industry where benzene is used as a component material to produce some daily life products. Prepare chart how is it used to produce that material in the industry and submit it to your teacher.

Exercise A. Multiple choice questions. 1. What is the molecular mass of benzene? a. 66 amu b. 68 amu c. 72 amu d. 78 amu 2. Study the given figure and identify the compound that would be produced in the given round bottomed flask?
a. Benzene b. Benzene sulphonic acid c. Nitrobenzene d. Phenol
3. Which of the following chemical species is suitable in the blank?
a. C6H5O b. C6H5c. CO2 + H2O d. C6H6 4. Which of the following is a catalyst for Friedel-Crafts’ reaction? a. Conc. H2SO4 b. CH3Cl c. AlCl3 d. Conc. HNO3
